title: Verify: Current round route unit tests
description: Add a server routing test that seeds a temp repo with a world and a round and asserts the singular path serves 200, the plural path 404, and an unknown world 404.
technical_constraints: Use t.TempDir and httptest only; no live ports

steps.action:
Add a test that builds cfg with Storage.RepoPath=t.TempDir(), writes worlds/the-boys-room/world.yaml (same content as the theBoysRoomYAML const in backend/internal/world/world_test.go) and rounds/round-0000001/round.yaml ('id: round-0000001
number: 1
status: open
starts_at: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z
ends_at: 2026-01-02T00:00:00Z
') with os.MkdirAll and os.WriteFile, calls New(cfg, discard logger), then subtests request via httptest: /api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room/round/current expects 200 and body containing round-0000001; /api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room/rounds/current expects 404; /api/v1/worlds/unknown/round/current expects 404. Add imports os and path/filepath.
steps.expected: All three subtests pass, proving the spec path is routed and the old path is not.
